_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in the two values from your Meta app. config.json holds a secret - do not share it or commit it.
_redirectUri: Must match a Valid OAuth Redirect URI in your Meta app EXACTLY, including the trailing path. Meta requires https. Try the https://localhost form first (run: node server.mjs --https); if Meta rejects it, use a tunnel such as ngrok and paste that https URL here.
